description: Sixteen channels of a polyphonic signal each inverted or switched off by its own button, in 2HP

params.text: Inverts that channel while it is red, within the range the invert-mode switch sets
Acts on all sixteen invert buttons at once, toggling them unless the menu says to force them all on or all off
Chooses how an inverted channel is flipped: Bip. mirrors it about 0V, Uni. mirrors it about 5V, Gate turns a high into a low and a low into a high
Switches that channel off while it is red, either replacing it with the disable value or dropping it from the output
Acts on all sixteen disable buttons at once, toggling them unless the menu says to force them all on or all off
Chooses what switching a channel off means: Val replaces it with the disable value, Excl removes it from the output altogether
Sets the voltage a switched-off channel carries in Val mode, -10V to +10V

inputs.text: The polyphonic signal whose channels are inverted and switched off

outputs.text: Carries the input with the chosen channels inverted and the chosen ones replaced or removed

notes: with nothing patched the module puts out channels of its own: set a fixed polyphony on the menu, and in Gate mode the inverted channels come out high and the rest low
in Excl mode a changing number of disabled channels changes the output channel count, which many modules only notice every 256 cycles
menu: Polyphony: Auto, 1 (monophonic) up to 16 channels — fixes the number of output channels instead of following the input
Invert all-button mode: Set all to normal, Set all to inverted, Toggle all — chooses what the invert All button does
Disable all-button mode: Set all to enabled, Set all to disabled, Toggle all — chooses what the disable All button does
Gate mode: non-inverted channels: Pass through, High/low-gate — in Gate invert mode, chooses whether channels that are not inverted keep their voltage or come out as gates
Set all invert-buttons: To Normal, To Invert — sets all sixteen invert buttons without changing what the All button does
Set all Disable-buttons: To Enabled, To Disabled — sets all sixteen disable buttons without changing what the All button does
Clipping range — clamps every output to the range chosen, -12V to 12V unless you change it, and Off lets the output run to any voltage
Process quality: Audio, High, Balanced, Low, Very low — sets how often the module runs its algorithm, from every cycle down to every 256th; below Balanced a 1ms trigger can be missed
Gate-high detect-level — sets the voltage at which an incoming gate counts as high, 1V or more unless you change it
Gate-high output-level — sets the voltage a gate output carries while high, 10V unless you change it
Gate-low output-level — sets the voltage a gate output carries while low, 0V unless you change it
